title: Mile High Pinball
notes: Start Game asks for a ball first: pick an empty slot, choose a skin and confirm; the ball keeps your progress up the tower.
The left soft key or key 7 opens the pause menu, which has a hint for the current board.
N-Gage Arena is greyed out in the main menu, and the Bluetooth multiplayer needs a second N-Gage, so neither is available in the browser.

controls.source: The game's defaults, read from its Options > Key Configuration screen (flippers, power-ups, pause) and its welcome message. The soft keys and OK were observed in menus and in play. Publisher and year are from general knowledge of the game; its own logo screen names the developer, Bonus.com.
notes: Pinball layout: the left flipper is the left arrow, Z or left Shift; the right flipper is X, / or right Shift (key 5). C uses a power-up and P pauses.
On a gamepad the left shoulder or trigger (or pad left) is the left flipper and the right shoulder or trigger is the right flipper; Y uses a power-up, Start pauses, A selects and B goes back.

statusNote: Logos, title, main menu, options and ball creation work, and the first board (Castle Ruins) plays at full speed: both flippers, scoring and the pause menu were tried.
